meta.author: claude
meta.description: Stone wall, stepped, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Over budget: 72 blocks vs 60. Like the straight module, but the walk rises 1 block (stand at 5, then 6) up a stair in the middle; the parapet and its corbels step up with it. Merlons tile across joints: half merlon, crenel, merlon, crenel, merlon (the next module starts with its half merlon).
meta.changes: Quality check round 1: the merlon pattern changed across the whole set so modules tile end to end (a cobblestone-slab half merlon at x 0, merlons at x 2 and 4: neighbours now alternate high / low instead of two merlons side by side). The corbels of the high half (x 2..4) now step up with the parapet (upside-down stairs at y 5, air at y 4). Torches on the merlons at x 2 and 4, the lamp post on the low walk; the crenel fillers removed from L3 (an arrow barrel and more ivy instead).
